sloka: उभाव् अपि च शोक आर्ताव् अनाथौ कृपणौ वने ।क्षिप्रम् एव गमिष्यावः त्वया हीनौ यम क्षयम् ॥२-६४-३८॥
transliteration: ubhāv api ca śoka ārtāv anāthau kṛpaṇau vane ।kṣipram eva gamiṣyāvaḥ tvayā hīnau yama kṣayam ॥2-64-38॥

translations.english: 'Deserted by you and without any support in the forest, afflicted with grief and feeling miserable, both of us also will assuredly go to Yama's abode, quickly.
